# Petro Pavlov — Senior Full-Stack & AI Engineer

> Petromil "Petro" Pavlov. 10+ years shipping production software. Most recently on CData Virtuality's AI research team — solo-built a Cursor-style SQL AI copilot, shipped Q3 2025, demoed at Gartner D&A Summit 2025. Available for consulting and project work — primarily US, Canada, Israel; also EU/UK. Based in Sofia, Bulgaria. Remote-first.

## Case studies (long-form technical writeups)

- [Insight Draft — AI meeting SaaS, bot-free recording across Meet/Teams/Zoom](https://petropavlov.dev/case-studies/insight-draft): Chrome extension (Manifest V3), 6 parallel LLM call types per meeting, custom Hangfire fan-out/fan-in via Postgres atomic UPDATE, statistical-voting speaker mapping. .NET 8 + Postgres + Node + Angular. Co-founded by Petromil Pavlov; case study covers the systems he led.
- [Gramota — EU Digital Identity Wallet SDK (eIDAS 2)](https://petropavlov.dev/case-studies/gramota): TypeScript SDK monorepo, 15 published npm packages with Sigstore provenance, ~580 conformance tests + 31 live interop tests against EU reference infrastructure. OID4VP/OID4VCI/DPoP/DCQL/SD-JWT VC. End-to-end roundtrips against the EU reference Android wallet.

## Projects

- [Magistrat — AI legal assistant for Bulgarian law](https://magistrat.bg): AI assistant built on its own legal corpus — court cases, consolidated laws, EU law, the State Gazette, the commercial register — crawled from national registries into PostgreSQL and searched as one. Citations checkable to the article and the case. .NET, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, Angular, MCP.
- [Switchboard — several Claude accounts in one window](https://github.com/Dominent/claude-desk): open-source Electron + TypeScript desktop tool that runs the real Claude desktop app once per profile and hosts each instance as a tab or side by side. Owned Win32 windows on Windows, Accessibility-API pinning on macOS, all native calls through koffi FFI. Per-tab claude:// sign-in routing. MIT. Independent project, not affiliated with Anthropic.
- [Beacon — Angular 21 + Nx reference architecture](https://github.com/Dominent/beacon): zoneless Angular 21 issue tracker in an Nx 23 monorepo. Lint-enforced module boundaries, NgRx SignalStore, SSR with incremental hydration, local Nx plugin. Live demo linked from the repo.

## Blog

- [Hosting another app's window inside yours](https://petropavlov.dev/blog/hosting-another-apps-window-inside-yours): How Switchboard embeds the Claude desktop app's window. Why reparenting a Chromium window as a WS_CHILD drops every key press, why an owned window works, what macOS allows instead, koffi FFI without a native module, and routing a claude:// sign-in link on Windows when an MSIX package owns the scheme.
- [A/B testing a portfolio that gets 20 visits a day](https://petropavlov.dev/blog/ab-testing-a-portfolio-that-gets-20-visits-a-day): Built a self-hosted analytics + A/B framework into the portfolio. Did the math on whether to run it at low traffic. Honest take on sample-size thresholds, proxy-metric risk, and when A/B testing is the wrong tool. The framework has since been removed from the site; the post stays as written.
- [Blog index](https://petropavlov.dev/blog)
